The build environment used to generate this project had no installed Gradle and could not download the official wrapper JAR. `gradle-wrapper.jar` is therefore a small bootstrap launcher (source is available at `../../tools/GradleWrapperMain.java`) that downloads the Gradle distribution at the HTTPS URL in `gradle-wrapper.properties`, extracts it into the normal user Gradle cache, and launches it. It does not run Gradle commands other than those passed to `gradlew`.
